notes: Native ff_get_line stores the LF/CR terminator in the 32-byte buffer while it fits; the port mirrors this and sscanf treats it as whitespace.
After a CR, native un-reads any following non-LF byte, including a single last byte of the file (probed: the byte stays in the data).
Mirrored native INVALIDDATA refusals use containerRefusal(message,183); unmirrored refusals use the private PvfError (exit 1).
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed; packages/containers/src/index.ts is unchanged and tests import the module by path.
Setup durations: submodule 56 s, npm ci 9 s, reference:build 164 s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 58 s, baseline unit 77 s, final unit 74 s.
Evidence is from the Linux x86_64 oracle only.
